visual_brief: 奥列尼奥克河在雅库特北部，流经中西伯利亚高原北缘的苔原与稀疏落叶松泰加林，河谷两岸是低缓的岩石阶地和碎石滩，水色清冷，夏季短暂；不像勒拿河那样有成排的高耸石柱。易混：勒拿石柱、科雷马河。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。试过：Flickr CC（Olenek river / Olenyok / Olenyok river / Olenek / Оленёк / Оленек，最小尺寸放到 0 也是 0 条结果）；Openverse 504；WebSearch 只找到维基页面、地图与 viola.bz 转载的 Yandex 照片（许可不明）。理想画面描述：Summer aerial photograph of the Olenyok (Olenek) River in northern Yakutia, Siberia: a wide clear dark-blue river winding through sparse larch taiga and green tundra, low layered rocky banks and pale gravel bars, a few low flat-topped hills, clear Arctic light with high thin clouds, river curving through the frame as the main subject. Avoid: tall vertical rock pillars like the Lena Pillars, big cities, ice, sunset silhouettes, haze.
